component.name: Archtoys
component.summary: PowerToys-style tools for Linux: pick colors, copy text, measure the screen

description.p: Archtoys is a growing set of small tools for Linux in one native app, inspired by Microsoft PowerToys. It works on Wayland and X11 and is at home on KDE Plasma.

ul.li: Pick any pixel on any monitor, with a magnifier and arrow keys for precision
See the color's name among about 32,000, and find colors by name
Copy it as HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, OKLCH and more, edit and compare colors
Drag over any part of the screen and copy the text in it, even from images and videos
Measure a box, the space around a point, a width or a height, in px, cm or inches
Keep up to three boxes on the screen and copy their sizes at once

description.p: Archtoys works offline. Text Extractor uses Tesseract, which Archtoys installs from your system's packages when you turn it on, and downloads a language's data the first time it is needed.
